scope: Backfill original full-P6 station priors; antenna/LoS preflight; recover symmetric legacy full RF, generate five missing native LoS stores only after preflight. No silent replacement of native full-RF generation by legacy Method B.
source_arm_keys: 7 cases x 3 drifts x 50 seeds x A/B/C/D/E = 5250
backfill_selection: All contiguous same-XY RF yaw groups length >=5. All matching Tnone rows, including OUTSIDE_MASK. Missing base pose NOT_IN_TNONE. Never use truth to initialize estimator.
backfill_prediction: offline reconstruction only: transition(previous saved posterior, saved measured increments); F P F^T+G Q G^T. Preserve supplied after-odom/range/RF bytes; label reconstructed fields DERIVED.
new_native_full_RF: requires input/parity gate and separate recorded launch; not implied by legacy full H presence
noisy_body_blocker: Source sensor-v2 generates observations at fixed truth. No actuator acceleration/settling, slip-to-true-pose, arbitrary-yaw/XY RF evaluation or gain/noise floor model is frozen in the handoff. Do not invent true noisy-motion H from stored ideal-angle grid.
